name: Christmas * Flower
source:
This is where I die today's spin-off.  

"Since it's Christmas, why don't we go see the illuminations?"  

The first Christmas together with my girlfriend, Katou Yuka.
... who might be a little bit mischievous.  

(A short story solely about spending a sweet date with your mischievous, but love-struck girlfriend!)  

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/17532]Freem.ne[/url]]
